key_decisions.decision: Preserve the claim without harmonizing it with Joshua’s allotment list.

Preserve the ambiguous before-the-LORD assurance without strengthening it to explicit approval.
Choose a reading for the difficult power clause while preserving isolation and noting alternatives.
Keep divine-gift claim in the scouts’ speech and the contrast with unsuspecting residents.
Retain all four objects and the indirect suggestion without inserting a theft command.
Keep all objects and priest’s location without removing the next verse’s retelling.
Treat the compressed image-ephod phrase as the surrounding list, noting the missing conjunction.
Preserve intimidation, father/priest titles and the offered promotion.
Keep his delight and agency; do not add the cast image absent from this list.
Retain gods-I-made irony and his repeated question without authorial commentary.
Keep threat to household as well as Micah and the violent men’s disposition.
Keep the victims’ security beside the attack and burning, not a sanitized settlement.
Preserve the lack of rescue, isolation, geography and replacement settlement.
Follow the displayed Manasseh with its suspended-letter Moses reading explained; preserve land exile.
Keep the coexistence and time notice alongside the previous exile statement.
